result.instructions: Tools for AgencyZoom, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the new leads from this week and who they are assigned to."; "Which tasks are past due and who owns them?"; "Find the customer Maria Lopez and list her active policies.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes AgencyZoom data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run agencyzoom_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run agencyzoom_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run agencyzoom_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. agencyzoom_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: agencyzoom_search_leads
tools.title: Search leads
tools.description: Search sales leads in AgencyZoom with filters; returns name, contact details, status, pipeline stage, source, assigned producer, quoted and sold premium (in cents) and dates, paged. Names, e-mail and phone match by prefix. Use agencyzoom_list_pipelines for workflow/stage ids and agencyzoom_list_employees for producer ids. POST /v1/api/leads/list.

status.description: Lead status: 0 new, 1 quoted, 2 won, 3 lost, 4 contacted, 5 expired.

assigned_to.description: Producer/agent id the lead is assigned to.

workflow_stage_id.description: Stage id; several stage ids can be separated by '/'.

created_from.description: Lead created on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

created_to.description: Lead created on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

sold_period.description: Only leads sold in this period.

last_activity_from.description: Last activity on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

last_activity_to.description: Last activity on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: agencyzoom_get_lead
tools.title: Get lead
tools.description: One lead by id with full details: contact data, address, status, stage, source, assigned producer and CSR, premiums (cents), dates and custom fields. GET /v1/api/leads/{leadId}.

tools.name: agencyzoom_get_lead_notes
tools.title: Get lead notes
tools.description: The activity notes of a lead: type (note, e-mail, creation...), date, author, title and body. GET /v1/api/leads/{leadId}/notes.

tools.name: agencyzoom_get_lead_tasks
tools.title: Get lead tasks
tools.description: The tasks linked to a lead (open, done, cancelled) with due date, assignees and notes. GET /v1/api/leads/{leadId}/tasks.

tools.name: agencyzoom_get_lead_opportunities
tools.title: Get lead opportunities
tools.description: The opportunities (quoted lines of business) of a lead: carrier, product line, premium, items, status and property address. GET /v1/api/leads/{leadId}/opportunities.

tools.name: agencyzoom_search_customers
tools.title: Search customers
tools.description: Search customers (clients with at least one written policy) with filters; returns contact details, address, source, agent and a policy summary, paged. First/last name match partially. POST /v1/api/customers.

policy_type.description: Policy type (product line) id; see agencyzoom_list_product_lines.

agent_id.description: Agent id assigned to the policy.

created_from.description: Customer created on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

created_to.description: Customer created on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: agencyzoom_get_customer
tools.title: Get customer
tools.description: One customer by id with full details: contact data, address, source, agent, CSR, custom fields and policy summary. GET /v1/api/customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: agencyzoom_get_customer_policies
tools.title: Get customer policies
tools.description: The policies written through AgencyZoom for a customer: type, carrier, policy number, premium (cents), items, sold/effective/expiry dates, agent, CSR and status (0 cancelled, 1 active, 3 upcoming, 4 renewed, 10-13 active variants). GET /v1/api/customers/{customerId}/policies.

tools.name: agencyzoom_get_customer_tasks
tools.title: Get customer tasks
tools.description: The tasks linked to a customer (open, done, cancelled) with due date, assignees and notes. GET /v1/api/customers/{customerId}/tasks.

tools.name: agencyzoom_search_tasks
tools.title: Search tasks
tools.description: Search tasks across the agency: by status (open/completed), assignee, period (today, past due, next week...), type and creation date; returns title, due date, assignees, linked customer or lead and notes, paged. POST /v1/api/tasks/list.

created_from.description: Created on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

created_to.description: Created on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: agencyzoom_get_task
tools.title: Get task
tools.description: One task by id: title, status, due date, assignees, notes and the customer or lead it belongs to. GET /v1/api/tasks/{taskId}.

tools.name: agencyzoom_search_service_tickets
tools.title: Search service tickets
tools.description: Search service tickets (client service requests) by household name, status, category, priority, policy number and created/completed dates, paged. POST /v1/api/serviceTicket/service-tickets/list.

workflow_id.description: Service pipeline id; see agencyzoom_list_pipelines with type 'service'.

created_from.description: Created on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

created_to.description: Created on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

completed_from.description: Completed on or after this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

completed_to.description: Completed on or before this date, yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, starting at 0 (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_page.

tools.name: agencyzoom_get_sales_summary
tools.title: Get sales summary
tools.description: The dashboard sales summary for the agency or one producer: goals, month-to-date and today's sales, trending, and daily premium/revenue/items/policies for the period. Amounts are in cents. Read-only (a POST in AgencyZoom). POST /v1/api/dashboard-data/sales-data.

start_date.description: Custom period start, yyyy-mm-dd (use with end_date instead of period).

tools.name: agencyzoom_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines and stages
tools.description: The sales (lead) or service pipelines with their stages and ids. Needed to create leads or service tickets and to move a lead between stages. GET /v1/api/pipelines-and-stages.

tools.name: agencyzoom_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: The agency's employees: id, name, e-mail, phone, whether producer, active or owner. Use the ids to assign leads and tasks. GET /v1/api/employees.

tools.name: agencyzoom_list_lead_sources
tools.title: List lead sources
tools.description: The lead sources (id, name, category, whether sales from it count as sales). GET /v1/api/lead-sources.

tools.name: agencyzoom_list_carriers
tools.title: List carriers
tools.description: The insurance carriers configured in the agency (id, name, standard carrier code). GET /v1/api/carriers.

tools.name: agencyzoom_list_product_lines
tools.title: List product lines
tools.description: The policy types / product lines (id, name, category, standard product line code), for policy filters. GET /v1/api/product-lines.

tools.name: agencyzoom_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: The tags defined in the agency (id, name). GET /v1/api/tags.

tools.name: agencyzoom_list_service_ticket_options
tools.title: List service ticket categories and priorities
tools.description: The service ticket categories and priorities (id, name), needed to create a service ticket. GET /v1/api/service-categories and GET /v1/api/service-priorities.

annotations.title: List service ticket categories and priorities

tools.name: agencyzoom_create_lead
tools.title: Create lead
tools.description: WRITE: create a new sales lead in a pipeline stage. AgencyZoom requires the pipeline and stage (agencyzoom_list_pipelines), first name, e-mail, lead source, assigned producer and country. Creating a lead can trigger the agency's own automations (assignment, tasks, e-mails) in AgencyZoom. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two leads, so search first (agencyzoom_search_leads by e-mail or phone). POST /v1/api/leads/create.

assign_to.description: Producer/agent (employee) id to assign the lead to; see agencyzoom_list_employees.

country.description: Country of the lead, e.g. USA.

tools.name: agencyzoom_add_lead_note
tools.title: Add lead note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a lead's activity feed (visible to the agency's users; AgencyZoom does not send it to the customer). Not idempotent: calling twice adds two notes. POST /v1/api/leads/{leadId}/notes.

tools.name: agencyzoom_add_customer_note
tools.title: Add customer note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a customer's activity feed (visible to the agency's users; AgencyZoom does not send it to the customer). Not idempotent: calling twice adds two notes. POST /v1/api/customers/{customerId}/notes.

tools.name: agencyzoom_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create a task (to-do, call, e-mail or meeting) linked to a lead or customer, optionally assigned to an employee. The assignee may be notified by AgencyZoom. Link it with lead_id or customer_id (or contact_email, which AgencyZoom matches to a lead or customer). Not idempotent: calling twice creates two tasks. POST /v1/api/tasks.

due.description: Due date (yyyy-mm-dd) or date and time (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm), in the agency's local time.

contact_email.description: E-mail of the lead/customer, used to find the match when no id is given.

assignee_id.description: Employee id to assign the task to; see agencyzoom_list_employees.

time_specific.description: True when the time part of `due` matters (default: the whole day).

tools.name: agencyzoom_complete_task
tools.title: Complete task
tools.description: WRITE: mark a task as completed. Repeated calls may repeat notifications or automations; undo with agencyzoom_reopen_task. PUT /v1/api/tasks/{taskId}/completed.

tools.name: agencyzoom_reopen_task
tools.title: Reopen task
tools.description: WRITE: reopen a completed task, optionally with a comment. Repeated calls may repeat notifications or automations. PUT /v1/api/tasks/{taskId}/reopened.

tools.name: agencyzoom_move_lead_stage
tools.title: Move lead to a stage
tools.description: WRITE: move an active lead (a status check refuses leads already won, lost or x-dated) to another stage of a lead pipeline (workflow_id and workflow_stage_id from agencyzoom_list_pipelines). The lead stays active: it does not mark the lead won, lost or x-dated. Moving into a stage can trigger the agency's automations. The read and update are not atomic: a concurrent status change can be overwritten and reactivate a lead. Do not use while another process changes the same lead. Automations may repeat on repeated calls. PUT /v1/api/leads/{leadId}/stage.

tools.name: agencyzoom_create_service_ticket
tools.title: Create service ticket
tools.description: WRITE: open a service ticket for a customer in a service pipeline stage. Needs the pipeline and stage (agencyzoom_list_pipelines with type 'service'), a priority and a category (agencyzoom_list_service_ticket_options). The assigned CSR may be notified, and the agency's service automations can run. Not idempotent: calling twice opens two tickets. POST /v1/api/serviceTicket/service-tickets/create.

policy_ids.description: Policy ids (from agencyzoom_get_customer_policies) the ticket is about.
